en: A black-and-white postcard image depicting a group of people relaxing on lounge chairs in a grand indoor colonnaded area, likely part of a spa or thermal establishment. The architecture features arched windows and decorative columns. Several women, possibly staff, are standing, while mostly older individuals are seated or reclining. The scene conveys an early 20th-century European spa atmosphere. The text at the bottom provides details about the location.
